newsitem.title: UK: NWE LS straight-run fuel weaker, Russian thinner.
newsitem.headline: NWE LS straight-run fuel weaker, Russian thinner.

text.p: Softer crude took the wind out of NWE low sulphur straight-run's sails on Friday shaving $2-3 a tonne off prices.
Dealers said there was little European or U.S. demand for the material which was pegged in the high $130s fob NWE.
Russian straight-run has become harder to source, especially for low water content cargoes. Traders said E-4 was assessed at around formula +$2/+$3.
"It's not really being offered, it's been done on a very discreet basis," said one trader. There was unconfirmed talk that Russian rail freight rates might be raised next week.
